title: Butterfly — Discovery
script: This open-source notebook starts with a canvas, not a subscription pitch. Butterfly is a local-first, cross-platform note app. I want to see the workflow, not just the feature list. Import a sample PDF, write on it, and move one note without rebuilding the page. Then export the page and open it in another viewer. Handwriting, organization, and collaboration can behave very differently across devices and versions. Next I am using the same PDF in Butterfly and Goodnotes. What would make you switch?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Draw, import a PDF, annotate, move objects and export.
whyNow: A practical alternative deserves a current, version-specific check before a viewer changes workflow.
viewerGoal: Decide whether this recorded workflow fits their own devices, plan and needs.
hooks: This open-source notebook starts with a canvas, not a subscription pitch.
An open-source canvas for your PDF notes.
Write on the PDF, then check what leaves the app.
strongestHook: This open-source notebook starts with a canvas, not a subscription pitch.
directorBrief: Direct this as a useful discovery with one important limit: Draw, import a PDF, annotate, move objects and export. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: Use a supported available device and synthetic three-page PDF. Log OS, stylus/mouse, Butterfly version and platform status. Demonstrate import, writing, highlighting, moving a note and export if supported. Inspect exported PDF independently. Capture official local-first/platform claims and experimental feature labels separately from observed actions.
evidenceRequirements: Verify versions, platforms, preview labels and collaboration status.
